acoustics.0f9xn5t: Maison Sanguine conceives refined sonic architectures, equally precise in their foundations and in their expression, studied and calibrated for each property. Acoustics and mixing techniques add the final touch, turning every night into a true sonic work of art.
acoustics.0vr2gm0: Maison Sanguine shapes by hand every element of its sonic architecture, down to the slightest detail. While source placement and low-frequency alignment also serve a technical purpose, each decision is governed by an artistic approach, taking the form of distinct sonic behaviours such as perimeter fields, elevated sources, distributed bass, spatial trajectories and moments of deliberate silence. Today, calibration and fine-tuning account for a defining part of every production’s preparation.
acoustics.14jq7ml: Once designed, the system is meticulously installed and tuned on site. Before the first note is played, the Maison’s sound teams carry out a crucial procedure known as calibration, measuring and aligning level, phase, delay and coverage to ensure that sound flows seamlessly through every space of the property.
acoustics.155wg3l: Precise delays bring every source into perfect synchrony, so that sound reaches each guest as one coherent image.
acoustics.1gfqaks: Subwoofers are distributed, positioned and phase-aligned across the property to create a coherent physical field. The bass is felt evenly from one area to another, delivering depth without excess and preserving the clarity of the music.
acoustics.1xk7q7e: This technique is generally reserved for the most architectural spaces of the property.
acoustics.11p0xmt: The final tuning of a Maison Sanguine production is achieved by ear. After every measurement, the sound teams and the Season’s Master of Sound walk the property zone by zone, listening from the arrival to the dancefloor, from the terraces to the gardens. Each transition, each distance and each moment of silence is refined until the system disappears behind the music. This final listening brings a natural balance to every space, a refined finishing only achievable by hand.
acoustics.01rb24t: We create a sonic experience that inhabits every space and resonates long after the last note… Everything we produce is an expression of our sound architects’ craft.
acoustics.1ysm257: Founder and Creative Director, Maison Sanguine
acoustics.14de0fp: A production’s sonic envelope reflects the precision that lies within. Its carefully designed integration acts as a protective shield for the sound, containing it within the property and preserving its clarity from external constraints, all the while affording each space style and personality.
acoustics.07sqnak: Since its inception, Maison Sanguine has applied to the integration of its systems the same refinement found in its sound architecture, with sources discreetly woven into the scenography and the architecture of each property. Today, the contrast between presence and silence has become Maison Sanguine’s distinctive signature.
acoustics.1epb9gm: Maison Sanguine productions are shaped by highly creative and expressive soundscapes. Complex sound architecture is topped off with refined mixing, precise spatial movements and signature sonic moments.
acoustics.1h9yb7m: Sonic dramaturgy has been a Maison Sanguine speciality since its inception. With each Season, its sound architects work alongside the Master of Sound to create each production by starting with the final experience and working backwards, from the emotion to be felt to the system that will bring it to life. It is an art, balancing intention and engineering, that requires sonic mastery and profound knowledge of acoustics, spaces and mixing techniques.
acoustics.06ymsnc: The sonic weaving shaping every Maison Sanguine production requires a rare savoir-faire, developed within the Maison and enriched from Season to Season by its sound architects and Masters of Sound.

aspen.1ew2uli: Since its founding, Maison Sanguine has pursued a creative vision rooted in uncompromising standards and an unwavering quest for absolute mastery, shaped by the most distinctive territories. aspen.157w1tl: The Studio is joined by the Season's Master of Sound to explore the path they have forged, drawing inspiration from the influences, encounters and creative forces that have shaped their artistic journey.
aspen.0i1j8z3: For the Studio, every creation is an opportunity for collective expression. Behind every production stands a community of collaborators whose shared ambition challenges conventions and redefines creation.
aspen.158oubi: Bringing Maison Sanguine to Aspen has been special because it challenges so many parts of the way we create. We have always believed that winter and creativity can exist side by side. aspen.018nd3s: The dedicated spatial control framework coordinates sound distribution across the property, creating distinct atmospheres within a unified composition, where the chalet’s architecture itself becomes an instrument.

Conceived to translate the raw power of winter into a nocturnal experience, its creation relies on the mastery of craftsmanship, where precision, adaptation and creative ambition are central. Today, the Winter Edition finds a new expression in Aspen, at the heart of the Colorado Rockies, where the grandeur of the landscape and the force of the alpine elements provide a new territory for the Maison’s vision.

atmospheres.0vcnthx: Throughout the Seasons, Maison Sanguine explores new territories and atmospheres to shape avant-garde nocturnal experiences. atmospheres.1u72yhk: Winter, the season of resilience par excellence, has accompanied human history since its earliest beginnings. Harsh, powerful and untamed, it embodies strength, endurance and the gradual return of light. The means required to imagine, design and bring a winter night to life do not rely on elaborate artifice or spectacular installations, but rather on creative expertise and a thorough mastery of craftsmanship.
atmospheres.01fzqns: Since the company's founding, Maison Sanguine's creative team has drawn on the raw power of this season to create ambitious nocturnal productions that harmoniously combine natural force, untamed character and precision of execution.
atmospheres.1e40p5k: As spring unfolds, the international calendar gathers pace. Fashion, art, sport and contemporary culture converge in a succession of major events, making the season a defining moment for creativity and cultural dynamism. However, in the field of Haute Nuit, spring programming remained relatively understated until 2025, when Maison Sanguine launched its Spring Edition in response to changing lifestyles and this new cultural momentum.
atmospheres.11fi3ne: The convergence of spatial design, scenography and technical engineering elevates this production to the level of a true performance, translating the energy of the season into an ambitious nocturnal experience and opening up new horizons for the entire industry.
atmospheres.1byrz5y: Since ancient civilizations, solar celebrations have marked the arrival of summer, giving rise to gatherings whose traditions vary across cultures. With Rite of Summer, Maison Sanguine draws on these traditions to create a White Party celebrating the opening of the season.
atmospheres.1fujnoh: Launched in 2025 with the creation of the Seasons, Rite of Summer is built around a large-scale production centred on Jubilation, the Maison's founding ritual. Inspired by traditional solar rites, it brings together the arts and culture in a celebration conceived as an offering. Scenography, spatial design and audiovisual engineering contribute to establishing Rite of Summer as part of the summer tradition.
atmospheres.047zah2: Widely used in the film and scenography industries, the mastery of light is an essential element of visual composition. The use of directional light sources, projections and diffusion systems makes it possible to control contrasts, create cast shadows and sculpt volumes. Combined with atmospheric effects, these techniques make light beams visible, reveal textures and alter the perception of spaces. The combination of these methods provides precise control over depth and image composition.
atmospheres.18wpj31: For its autumn productions, Maison Sanguine applies these techniques to the art of nocturnal staging, drawing inspiration from cinematic production methods. Scenography, lighting design and audiovisual engineering are brought together under a unified artistic direction to create immersive environments. The control of light sources, the composition of volumes and the mastery of atmospheres make it possible to develop a distinctive visual dramaturgy of the night.
atmospheres.1dkskl0: For millennia, the passage of time has been a source of celebration, marking achievements and giving rise to new ambitions. Through its creative explorations and the territories it engages with, Maison Sanguine develops a distinctive language of its own. Tonight, the studio celebrates the journey so far while embracing the possibilities that lie ahead.
atmospheres.1gy53j6: For MSNYE, the studio brings its Absolute Mastery to the achievements that have defined the season. origins.1rdr5kh: Our story begins in Paris, where nightlife entertainment has been written for more than 140 years. Here, the audacity of people, the scenography of places, and the resilience of time have shaped a savoir-faire that Maison Sanguine draws on and reinvents today.
origins.103kql2: Driven by the power of unity and an insatiable desire to push beyond the boundaries of the ordinary, we rise to every challenge, taking our time to create the extraordinary.
origins.1y8esy0: The vibrant city of Paris, birthplace of Maison Sanguine and one of the world’s leading centres of culture and entertainment, is a city shaped by centuries of history, art and architecture. The capital’s cultural resources, including its historic buildings, art galleries, iconic addresses and emblematic neighbourhoods, have enabled the hospitality and entertainment industries to evolve and thrive. To this day, the city’s artistic richness and architectural beauty continue to inspire creators, reflecting the timeless connection between art, architecture and entertainment.
origins.04j8sat: During the 19th century, Parisian cafés, cabarets and entertainment venues began to emerge as the heart of a thriving nightlife. Artists, writers and musicians transformed these popular places into spaces for creativity, encounter and freedom. This vibrant network of venues and cultural figures, developed across the capital, would go on to shape some of the most iconic establishments in the history of Parisian nightlife. The foundations of Maison Sanguine lie in this remarkable nocturnal heritage, which it draws on and reinvents today.
origins.0q7lsx2: Since its founding, the Studio has applied its savoir-faire at the highest level. Guided by the Maison's vision, it continually reinvents its craft, creating experiences where excellence converges with creativity and innovation.
origins.1nyskya: Guided by its founder’s vision, Maison Sanguine is driven by a unique spirit of independence. His visionary approach and uncompromising standards shape the brand’s identity today.
origins.174e2x9: Maison Sanguine is more than a company. It remains independent, dedicated to passing on its discipline in the art of celebration through time. Through every experience, around the world, we cultivate the same standard of excellence, that of creating the unforgettable. Here, in Paris, where it all begins.

origins.0au0oj0: Bryan Booker established the Studio in Paris. The studio is at the heart of this approach, a space where creators imagine, shape and bring to life a new standard of entertainment, with meticulous attention to every detail. Every production takes shape here with the same commitment to excellence, from the initial idea through to its realization.
origins.1myimc1: Maison Sanguine cultivates a resolutely exclusive approach to creation, through distinctive editions that express its forward-thinking vision of savoir-faire.
origins.0ws6cix: Today, Maison Sanguine carries a clear ambition, to redefine the entertainment of tomorrow. To achieve this, it builds and develops each of its disciplines for the long term, driven by an uncompromising commitment to creativity, innovation, and excellence.

productions.0bs9yzh: Maison Sanguine redefines traditional entertainment with nights that combine technical innovation and creativity. From the precision of its scenography to the intensity of its sound and immersive atmospheres, each production showcases our commitment to excellence in Haute Nuit.
productions.1c4lh71: Born from dedicated research and the collaboration of exceptional talents across disciplines, Absolute Mastery is the shared framework that guides every production, from the first idea to the last minute of the night.
productions.1493wek: Powered by the Maison’s research into architecture, sound and immersion, this framework brings five disciplines together under a common set of principles: creative direction, spatial design, scenography, sound architecture and technical engineering, continuously refined to guide the design and execution of each production.
productions.01iwggf: Bringing together the Maison’s creative and technical savoir-faire in a single production, built around five complementary disciplines.
productions.1vshua0: Every night begins with a founding vision. Creative Direction defines its identity, aesthetic language and underlying intentions, establishing the guiding principles that shape the entire production. From initial research to final execution, it ensures consistency across spatial, scenographic, sound and technical decisions, allowing every intervention to contribute to a singular vision.
productions.0luy43c: The experience takes shape through the organisation of space. Spatial Design defines volumes, circulation, perspectives and the relationships between distinct areas, taking into account the existing architecture and the intended use of the site. It structures the sequences of the night, from arrival and gathering spaces to more intimate areas, creating a fluid progression in which every space fulfils its role within the whole.
productions.1c69war: Scenography translates creative intent into a physical presence. Structures, installations, materials and visual elements are conceived in response to the architecture and distinctive characteristics of each location, whether a private estate, a natural environment or a vessel. Drawing on existing lines, volumes and perspectives, each intervention reveals the character of the site while introducing a new interpretation without erasing its identity.
productions.1w6m7xe: Sound is conceived as an integral component of space. In dialogue with Creative Direction and the season’s artist, Sound Architecture considers the acoustics, materials, volumes and guest configuration of each location to determine the most appropriate sound distribution. Source positioning, spatialisation, elevated sound sources and low-frequency control are studied as a unified system, while EXTEND™ brings this approach to life through multidirectional sound distribution designed to complement the experience of the space.
productions.191k9i7: Every intention must be translated into a reliable and precisely controlled system. Technical Engineering coordinates structures, lighting, sound, power supply and control systems within a unified operational framework. Structural calculations, system integration, safety requirements and site constraints are assessed from the earliest stages of preparation, then verified during installation and on-site testing to ensure compatibility between systems and uninterrupted operation throughout the night.
productions.0zlz1tx: Born from 150 cumulative weeks of research, design and creative mastery, the Seasons bring together all of the Maison’s savoir-faire in a collection of exclusive nocturnal productions, driven by a collaborative, interdisciplinary approach and shaped down to the finest detail.
productions.18nky63: With each Season, a leading, multi-award-winning artist from the international music scene joins Maison Sanguine’s creative studio to contribute to the direction of its sound architecture. Working closely with the Maison’s team, the artist shapes a distinct musical vision, conceived in dialogue with the space, scenography and identity of each production.
productions.10wlvuk: At the intersection of artistic expression and technical mastery, sound architecture stands as an essential discipline within the Maison’s savoir-faire. Each collaboration explores new possibilities in sound creation, live performance and immersion, placing music at the heart of the architecture of the night.
productions.1cg7nkw: EXTEND combines spatial audio, distributed sound and low-frequency architecture within a proprietary system designed around the specific characteristics of each property. Through a mapped network of sound sources and a dedicated spatial control framework, music can be positioned, moved and distributed across distinct areas, transforming the architecture itself into an instrument.
productions.1g7pazh: To create a Maison Sanguine production, five disciplines must come together: creative direction, spatial design, scenography, sound architecture and technical engineering.
productions.1sdsrhh: Since its inception, Maison Sanguine has developed a savoir-faire where creative research meets technical mastery, transforming each location into an immersive nocturnal experience, conceived down to the finest detail.

sustainability.1wb5dme: Our Origins, Our Present, Our Future
sustainability.1m03rfb: In 2023, Bryan Booker laid the foundations of Maison Sanguine with a clear ambition: to create exceptional experiences that endure in memory. Rooted in the Parisian art of the night and shaped by a global perspective, the Maison has evolved through the dialogue between people, places and time.
sustainability.1ffyndy: Guided by a long-term vision, Maison Sanguine places its relationships with partners, guests and local communities at the heart of its approach. Each Season is conceived with consideration for the destinations that host it, reflecting a commitment to building lasting relationships and creating value beyond the experience itself.
sustainability.050k7aw: As an independent House, Maison Sanguine retains the freedom to pursue a vision beyond immediate horizons. With this independence comes a responsibility to contribute to the evolution of entertainment, fostering a more considered approach to its creation and a greater commitment to sustainability.
sustainability.0xr7e8j: Our sustainability approach begins with an understanding of our value chain and the environmental and social considerations associated with our activities. This perspective enables us to identify and prioritise the areas where our decisions can have the greatest impact.
sustainability.0c9oxvt: Our Sustainability Framework is built around three pillars: Environment, People and Communities, and Governance. These pillars encompass six priority areas that guide our approach: climate change, materials, our people, entertainment savoir-faire, our communities and business ethics.
sustainability.1menfpy: Anticipate, reduce and reuse our impact
sustainability.1cgad09: Every edition begins in a place, with its landscape, its climate and its rhythms. Drawing inspiration from the destinations that welcome us, we design nights that respect their setting. Today, we build on this approach by strengthening our commitment to environmental stewardship. Protecting the places we celebrate in is integral to our craft; it supports the preservation of our savoir-faire and the global value chain on which it depends.
sustainability.0bfrtqj: Nurture and share a living craft with our people and our communities.
sustainability.04k8iqo: We trace our roots to the Parisian art of entertainment and hospitality, a network of highly specialised talents who collectively shape each edition with precision and care.
sustainability.0cl2f7m: This spirit of shared expertise and mutual respect continues to define our identity today. We aim to create an environment where our teams and collaborators can thrive, enriching and transmitting our craft to the next generation of entertainment. We support shared prosperity across our partners and the communities that welcome each edition.
sustainability.0vcw7si: Sustainability is embedded in our long-term vision and guided at the highest level of the Maison. Our governance is built on continuity, discretion, stewardship and disciplined decision-making, framed by our Code of Conduct and protocols. We see our network of partners and suppliers as a lever to address today’s social and environmental challenges, placing collaboration at the heart of our approach.
